天真无邪,残酷的阿卡拉的守护\\n神。鲜花的芳香气息是它能量的\\n来源。: The guardian deity of Akala, both innocent and cruel. The fragrant scent of flowers is the source of its energy.

容易消逝的气体状身体。一边收\\n集大气的尘埃,一边慢慢地成长\\n着。: Its gaseous body is frail and fleeting. It grows slowly as it gathers dust from the atmosphere.
就像死了一般几乎不动,但触碰\\n后有些许温暖。在遥远的过去被\\n称为星之茧。: It stays as still as if it were dead, yet it feels slightly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

500多年前被制造出的人造宝\\n可梦。理解人类的语言但不会说\\n。: An artificial Pokémon built more than 500 years ago. It understands human speech but cannot speak itself.

能够通过打鼓来控制特别的\\n树桩中的力量,\\n操纵树根进行战斗。: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special stump and manipulates tree roots to fight.
一旦做好了战斗的准备,\\n它鼻头上和脚底的肉球\\n就会发出极度的高温。: Once it's ready for battle, the pads on its nose and the soles of its feet radiate tremendous heat.

身上隐藏着多种特殊能力,\\n例如从手指喷射水流,\\n以及用背部的翼膜滑翔等等: Many special abilities are hidden in its body, such as shooting water from its fingertips and gliding on the membranes on its back.

以头脑聪慧而闻名。\\n大大的脑子是它拥有\\n出众精神力量的证明。: Famous for its high intelligence. Its large brain is proof of its exceptional psychic power.
性格谨慎且狡猾。\\n在偷盗食物逃走的时候\\n会用尾巴擦掉自己的足迹。: Cautious and cunning, it uses its tail to wipe away its footprints as it flees with stolen food.
会偷偷在看中的猎物身上\\n留下标记,追踪目标的气味,\\n在对方放松警戒时偷盗: It secretly marks its chosen prey, tracks the target's scent, and steals from it the moment its guard is down.
当它把单脚扎进地面里,\\n并且汔浴充分的阳光,\\n花瓣就会染上鲜艳的颜色。: When it plants one foot in the ground and bathes in plenty of sunlight, its petals take on vivid colors.
棉絮的种子营养丰富。它会\\n通过风散播种子,让草木\\n和宝可梦变得活力十足。: The seeds in its cotton fluff are packed with nutrients. It spreads them on the wind, filling plants and Pokémon with vitality.

性格凶暴的宝可梦。\\n会用能咬断铁棍的\\n颉部大口咬住猎物。: A ferocious Pokémon. It clamps down on prey with jaws that can bite clean through iron bars.
因为想要得到零食而帮助\\n人类工作的贪吃鬼。\\n总是带着电火花跑来跑去。: A glutton that helps people with their work just to earn treats. It's always dashing about, trailing crackling sparks.

靠储存在体内的可燃气体\\n来发热。热度最高的是\\n腹部的黄色部分。: It produces heat with the combustible gas stored in its body. The yellow part of its belly burns hottest.

通过头部的突起物来\\n感应生物的情感。\\n只对温和的人敞开心熹。: It senses the emotions of living things with the protrusion on its head. It opens its heart only to gentle people.

总是饿着肚子。\\n会吃掉装在像口袋一样的\\n袋子里的种子来发电。: It's always hungry. It generates electricity by eating the seeds it keeps in its pocket-like pouches.

群居的宝可梦。\\n鼻子的握力十分强劲,\\n甚至能把大石头弄得粉碎。: A Pokémon that lives in herds. Its trunk grips with such strength that it can crush a boulder to pieces.
会用尾部结实的肌肉发电。\\n与下半身相比,\\n上半身真的太小了。: It generates electricity with the sturdy muscles of its tail. Compared to its lower half, its upper body is simply too small.
它冻成冰的上半身在\\n颤抖后可以产生电能。\\n非常不擅长走路。: Its frozen upper half produces electricity when it shivers. It's very poor at walking.

它角里的多龙梅西亚似乎\\n满心期待着能被以\\n音速发射出去。: The Dreepy in its horns seem to look forward eagerly to being launched at supersonic speed.
被称为妖精王之剑,让敌友\\n都对其敬畏不已。能以一剑\\n将超极巨化宝可梦拿下: Known as the Fairy King's Sword, it is held in awe by friend and foe alike. A single stroke of its blade can fell a Gigantamax Pokémon.
被称为格斗王之盾,受到人\\n们的畏惧与尊崇。能轻易抵\\n挡超极巨化宝可梦的攻: Known as the Fighting Master's Shield, it is feared and revered. It can easily deflect the attacks of Gigantamax Pokémon.
会用胸部的核心吸收\\n佚勒尔地区涌出的能量,\\n借以保持自己的活力。: It absorbs the energy welling up from the Galar region through the core on its chest to keep itself active.
拉紧头上又白又长的体毛\\n就变得斗气势高昂,\\n并从丹田涌出力量。: When it pulls the long white fur on its head taut, its fighting spirit soars and power surges up from deep within.
流派不同, 分别会像水流一样\\n毫不停息地用打击招式攻击对手。\\n或是用千锤: Depending on its style, it either batters foes with a ceaseless flow of strikes like rushing water, or fells them in one blow with a well-forged fist.
